behaviors.name: Collect
behaviors.intent: Spin; when the hero touches it, pop and count, then come back later.
behaviors.source:
behavior Collect
  var away = 0
  on tick
    rotate self by (0, 0, 200 * dt)
    away = max(0, away - dt)
    let h = find("Hero")
    if away == 0 and distance(self, h) < 1.3 then
      emit "coin" to h
      away = 8
    end
    if away > 0 then
      self.scale = (0.01, 0.01, 0.01)
    else
      self.scale = (0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Platforming
behaviors.intent: Run around the island ring and jump each gap in a big arc, landing on the next island.
behaviors.source:
behavior Platforming
  on tick
    let a = time * 0.33
    let u = (a % 1.04720) / 1.04720
    let p = (u + 0.17) % 1
    let h = 0
    if p < 0.34 then
      h = sin(p / 0.34 * pi) * 2.6
    end
    self.position = (cos(a) * 14.0, h, sin(a) * 14.0)
    self.rotation = (0, 0 - a * 57.3, 0)
    if p < 0.34 then
      self.scale = (0.9, 1.15, 0.9)
    else
      let b = abs(sin(time * 12)) * 0.07
      self.scale = (1 + b * 0.5, 1 - b, 1 + b * 0.5)
    end
  end
  on event "coin"
    self.coins = self.coins + 1
  end
end

behaviors.name: Chase
behaviors.intent: Chase the hero from outside the ring, looking in toward the castle.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let h = find("Hero")
  let a = time * 0.33 - 0.35
  self.position = lerp(self.position, (cos(a) * 24.0, 6.5, sin(a) * 24.0), 0.08)
  look self at (h.position.x * 0.7, 1.5, h.position.z * 0.7)
end
